_comment: Registry behind knownBug(id, ...) in support/fixtures.ts. status open: the test is expected to fail (test.fail) and turns red the day the product is fixed, then set it to fixed. status fixed: the marker is inert and the test is a regression guard. Open entries carry test, steps, expected, actual, evidence and fix. Fixed entries may carry resolution (what was done) and, for an intended deviation, the new expectation the test must assert. Run with E2E_BUG_REPORT=1 to see the raw failures of the open ones.

BUG-01.title: Logout does not revoke the session server-side and keeps studio hub connections open (GAP-04b)

BUG-02.title: GET /api/system/info answers anonymously and anonymous POST /api/auth/logout answers 204 (route policy matrix, GAP-04a)

BUG-03.title: A request without the X-Output-Key header answers 400 instead of the uniform 403 (GAP-06)

BUG-04.title: Credential-bearing responses (livekit-token, redeem, pairing poll) lack Cache-Control: no-store

BUG-05.title: LiveKit webhook answers 415 for Content-Type application/json (plan expects 200; LiveKit itself sends application/webhook+json)
BUG-05.resolution: 2026-10-22: the webhook route accepts application/webhook+json and application/json (other types 415). Tests: RequestContractTests.Webhook_* (apps/api/tests/Opten.StudioFlow.Web.Tests).

BUG-06.title: Releasing an unknown slot answers 204 and a phone may release its only camera slot (GAP-19)

BUG-07.title: The loser of a double approve gets 410 instead of 404 (GAP-09)

BUG-08.title: An unknown enum text (kind: tablet) is a 400 without the errors object naming the field
BUG-08.resolution: 2026-10-22: body binding errors (unknown enum text, wrong JSON type, broken JSON) throw in every environment and become 400 validation_failed with errors naming the camelCase field path (kind, items[0].fit; body for the body as a whole), message «Ungültiger Wert.», no serializer or .NET type text. Tests: RequestContractTests.*Enum*, *WrongTypeOrBrokenJson*, DatabaseResilienceUnitTests.FieldOf_*.

BUG-09.title: The device kind comes from the request body, not from the invite kind (GAP-19)

BUG-10.title: Log texts of block/unblock/remove contain the device name («K1 Handy 1 gesperrt»); prototype and plan had «K1 gesperrt»
BUG-10.resolution: 2026-10-22: intended deviation, not a bug. The product keeps «{codes} {device name} gesperrt|entsperrt|entfernt» (more informative for multi-slot devices: «S1 S2 Laptop Mia gesperrt»); the Regie toasts stay code-only («K1 gesperrt und getrennt», «K1 entsperrt»). docs/testing.md (INT-PAIR-12, 2.5 strings, E2E-SRC-10, 7.2) now pins the product text.
BUG-10.expected: INT-PAIR-12 [stack, log texts] must assert «K1 Handy 1 gesperrt» and «K1 Handy 1 entsperrt» (harness change pending).

BUG-11.title: Pending knock requests survive the activation of another production (GAP-36)

BUG-12.title: Image dimension limit is 65535, not the pinned 16384; a 60000 x 60000 header is accepted (GAP-13)

BUG-13.title: Asset content without any credential answers 403 instead of 401 (GAP-13)

BUG-14.title: Asset content has no ETag; If-Range with a non-matching validator still answers 206

BUG-15.title: File name sanitiser keeps U+202E and dot-only names; fallback name differs from the pinned «Medium» (UNIT-MEDIA-01)

BUG-16.title: HEAD on the asset content endpoint answers 405
BUG-16.resolution: 2026-10-22: HEAD is mapped next to GET (same handler, not part of the OpenAPI contract): the headers of GET (type, length, ETag, Accept-Ranges, Cache-Control, disposition, CSP, nosniff) without body, 206 with Content-Range for a range, 401/403 like GET. Tests: RequestContractTests.ContentHead_*.

BUG-18.title: X-Content-Type-Options is sent twice on API responses (API and Caddy both add it)
BUG-18.resolution: 2026-10-22: Caddy sets the header for every response and drops the upstream copy (header_down -X-Content-Type-Options) for /api, /hubs and /rtc; the API keeps sending it for direct access. Verified with the built image (fake upstream sending nosniff): before 2 headers on /api/auth/me, /hubs/studio/negotiate and /rtc/validate, after exactly 1; static files, redirects, 404s and a 502 of a stopped upstream unchanged at 1.

BUG-19.title: Device reports are relayed to the Regie as telemetry at once (no 2 s throttle per device)
BUG-19.resolution: 2026-10-22: the first report of a device is relayed at once, later ones at most once per device and Sources:TelemetryInterval (2 s); reports in between are held back and the newest one is relayed by the 1 s maintenance tick once the interval has passed (latest value wins). Revisioned events (source status, device connection, tech check) are not throttled. Tests: ThrottleAndShutdownTests (Core), ShutdownAndTelemetryTests.Report_TenPerSecond_* (Web).

BUG-20.title: A graceful API shutdown (docker restart / compose restart / update) writes a «K1 verbindet neu» log entry for every source in Program or Preview although the restart is no outage of the source
BUG-20.resolution: 2026-10-22: while the host stops (ApplicationStopping) device, Regie and output hub disconnects are not evaluated and nothing is written (no log entry, no incident, no event); the maintenance loops end at once. After the restart the restart watch of spec 12 (GAP-08 b) flags a source on air whose device does not return within 15 s. Tests: ThrottleAndShutdownTests.DisconnectedAsync_* (Core), ShutdownAndTelemetryTests.StopApplication_* (Web).

BUG-21.title: With PostgreSQL stopped, every request that needs the database hung for 16-46 s before the API answered 503; through Caddy a plain-text 504 after 30 s (GAP-32)
BUG-21.resolution: 2026-10-22: connect timeout 3 s, command timeout 5 s, cancellation timeout 1 s (Database:ConnectTimeout, Database:CommandTimeout); a connection that cannot be established or a statement without answer opens a circuit: every operation then fails at once with a transient error (503 service_unavailable, Retry-After 5) instead of waiting for its own timeout and queueing behind device reports of the same production; a probe connection every Database:ProbeInterval (1 s) closes it, so readiness and writes recover without a restart; broken pooled connections are cleared. Startup waits up to Database:StartupWait (60 s) for PostgreSQL. Tests: DatabaseOutageTests (refused and silent database, ten reports per second in parallel: read, write and login answer 503 within 6 s, then at once; readiness back within seconds), DatabaseResilienceUnitTests.

BUG-22.title: The postgres service has no cap_drop: ALL (caddy, api and livekit have it); E2E-OPS-01 and -13 require it for every service
BUG-22.resolution: 2026-10-22: postgres runs with cap_drop [ALL] and cap_add [CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER, SETGID, SETUID] (what the official entrypoint needs before it drops to the postgres user). Verified with the real compose service (isolated project): fresh volume initialised and healthy, restart on the non-empty volume healthy (without DAC_OVERRIDE the entrypoint fails: find: Permission denied), pg_dump/docker cp/pg_restore as backup.sh and restore.sh use them work.

DOC-01.title: docs/testing.md pinned microphone=() for /join/*; implementation-spec section 10 and the Caddyfile have microphone=(self)
DOC-01.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md E2E-AUTH-09 now pins microphone=(self) for /join/*.
DOC-01.expected: E2E-AUTH-09 [sender microphone] must assert microphone=(self) (harness change pending).

DOC-02.title: Event order of a redeem differs from the order pinned in INT-PAIR-01: the API emits inviteRemoved first and the replacement inviteUpserted last (no functional impact)
DOC-02.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md INT-PAIR-01 now pins inviteRemoved, deviceUpserted, sourceUpserted, logAppended, inviteUpserted.
DOC-02.expected: E2E-PAIR-01 [api, event order] must assert the implemented order (harness change pending).

DOC-03.title: docs/testing.md pinned a LiveKit participant token lifetime of 2 h; implementation-spec section 7 and the API use 10 minutes
DOC-03.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md (1.2.6, GAP-01, UNIT-LK-01, INT-LK-01, T-LIMITS) now pins 10 minutes.

DOC-04.title: docs/testing.md E2E-OPS-06 and E2E-NET-13 used docker kill to simulate a crash; since Docker 29 a killed container counts as manually stopped and the restart policy does not bring it back
DOC-04.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md (1.6, E2E-OPS-06, E2E-NET-12, E2E-NET-13) now crashes with kill -TERM 1 inside the container (-QUIT for PostgreSQL).
DOC-04.expected: E2E-OPS-06 [stack, DOC-04] must crash with kill -TERM 1 (dockerCtl.crash) instead of docker kill, or be removed (harness change pending).

DOC-05.title: docs/testing.md E2E-OPS-02 listed an empty domain as invalid input; setup.sh uses the node IP as the domain in internal mode (its prompt says so), with a public TLS mode it is an error
DOC-05.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md E2E-OPS-02 now pins this behaviour.
DOC-05.expected: E2E-OPS-02 [setup.sh] empty domain must assert exit 0 and STUDIOFLOW_DOMAIN = the node IP in mode internal (harness change pending).

DOC-06.title: docs/testing.md UNIT-SRC-01 / INT-SRC-03 / E2E-SRC pinned slot state paused = ended; implementation-spec 4.5 makes paused = the OS suspended the capture = reconnecting, ended = stopped on purpose, and replaces slot states per report / per session
DOC-06.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md (UNIT-SRC-01/02/03, E2E-SRC-19, GAP-08) now follows implementation-spec 4.5 and 12.

DOC-07.title: docs/testing.md E2E-OPS-05 degraded a service with docker pause and expected unhealthy within interval x retries; Docker 29.8.2 marks a paused container unhealthy at once, even for a check that is just 'true'
DOC-07.resolution: 2026-10-22: docs/testing.md E2E-OPS-05 now uses the [command] method: the check runs in the container (exit 0) and in a container of the same image without the service (exit != 0).

OBS-01.title: Graceful shutdown of the API with connected hub clients is slow and erratic: 0.6 s without clients, but 31-32 s (the 30 s default HostOptions.ShutdownTimeout) in some runs; once 59.8 s on a loaded machine
OBS-01.resolution: 2026-10-22: every hub connection is aborted on ApplicationStopping (the clients reconnect at once and Kestrel does not wait for the WebSockets), HostOptions.ShutdownTimeout is 5 s (below Docker's 10 s grace), the maintenance loops stop on ApplicationStopping and the disconnect handlers do no database work while stopping. Test: ShutdownAndTelemetryTests.StopApplication_* (device, Regie and output hubs connected: all closed < 2 s, host stopped < 4 s).
